newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Hills to make offer for Woodroffe.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Hills to make offer for Woodroffe.

text.p: Diversified manufacturer Hills Industries Ltd said on Friday it would offer 75 cents a share for the 50.18 percent of Woodroffe Industries Ltd it does not already own.

Woodroffe has been a controlled entity of Hills since February 1994. Hills said the offer represented a 15.7 percent premium over the weighted average price of Woodroffe shares traded since July 1, 1996.
Woodroffe, which has a market capitalisation at about A$11.5 million, supplies roll-formed metal to the building industry.
Hills chairman Bob Hill-Ling said the company believed it would be better able to fund Woodroffe's continued growth if it were to become a wholly owned subsidiary.
Offer documents were expected to be served in three weeks, and the bid was conditional on Hills winning 90 percent of Woodroffe's issued shares.
